correctness.rationale: For binary words, changing a set of positions is exactly a Hamming move, so k-delicacy is equivalent to Hamming isolation at least k+1 inside the fixed-length overlap-free language. Two independent exact enumerators agree on every overlap-free word through length 14. The resulting complete isolation profiles have maximum at most 2 through length 12, exactly 3 at length 13, at most 3 through length 13, and exactly 4 at length 14. This proves L_2=13 and L_3=14 and exhausts all shortest equality cases. The certificate and replay script are bundled and were run from their packaged paths.
